answer_needs_sean.question: How much is Passport, and how is it different from the $11 Founding Membership?
answer_needs_sean.answer: The $11 Founding Membership is a one-time contribution that makes you a member. Passport is an optional upgrade on top of it: $11 a month or $111 a year. Each renewal adds 1,100 points, and Passport lets you choose your Guide and gives you 300 Guide points a month instead of 60.

answer_needs_sean.question: Who can claim Bounties: any member, or only Passport holders?
answer_needs_sean.answer: Any active member can claim a Bounty spot. Sign in and open Bounties from your dashboard or your city hub.

answer_needs_sean.question: Do I need a game ticket for the Plant-Based Showcase, and is it free?
answer_needs_sean.answer: The Showcase is free with your regular game ticket for the Dolphins vs. Jets on Sunday, November 29, 2026, at Hard Rock Stadium. There is no separate Showcase ticket.

answer_needs_sean.question: What are the Community Night dates?
answer_needs_sean.answer: In South Florida: the launch Community Night is Saturday, October 24 in West Palm Beach, then Saturday, November 21 in Miami and Saturday, December 12 in Fort Lauderdale. The Plant-Based Showcase is Sunday, November 29 at Hard Rock Stadium.

answer_needs_sean.question: Does South Florida have a Community Manager?
answer_needs_sean.answer: Yes. South Florida is our first chapter, and its Community Manager is helping it get started now. Other cities are still looking for theirs, and open roles are under Opportunities on your dashboard.

answer_needs_sean.question: Which cities are next after South Florida?
answer_needs_sean.answer: Central Florida (Orlando) and New York are next, then Los Angeles.

answer_needs_sean.question: How many points does a guide cost: 1,100 or 1,111?
answer_needs_sean.answer: Guides are 1,111 points each, and the Welcome Guide is free.

answer_needs_sean.question: Can I buy points packages?
answer_needs_sean.answer: Points come from contributing: every dollar becomes 100 points. Members can contribute any time with the Contribute button on the dashboard, $11 or more.

answer_needs_sean.question: How do I contact you if I'm not a member (about, policies, contact, privacy, terms)?
answer_needs_sean.answer: Email hello@vegansexplore.com and the team will get back to you. Members can also tap Ask a person in their Guide.

answer_needs_sean.question: Is there a Vegans Explore app?
answer_needs_sean.answer: Not yet. Vegans Explore works in your phone's browser, and you can add it to your home screen so it opens like an app.

answer_needs_sean.question: Can I get a refund or cancel my membership?
answer_needs_sean.answer: Your Founding Membership is a one-time contribution, so there is nothing to cancel. If something went wrong with a payment, tap Ask a person or email hello@vegansexplore.com and the team will sort it out.
also_asked: can i get my money back

answer_needs_sean.question: How do I delete my account or change my email?
answer_needs_sean.answer: Tap Ask a person, or email hello@vegansexplore.com from the address on your account, and the team will take care of it.

answer_needs_sean.question: How do I suggest a Vegan place that isn't in the Directory?
answer_needs_sean.answer: Tap Ask a person with the place's name and city, and the team will look at adding it. If you own the business, you can claim its listing on the claim page.
also_asked: add a place to the directory

answer_needs_sean.question: Is Vegans Explore a nonprofit?
answer_needs_sean.answer: Yes. Vegans Explore is run by Vegans Explore Inc., a Florida nonprofit corporation. Your $11 is a membership contribution, not a tax-deductible donation.

answer_needs_sean.question: What are Passport Stop and Passport Anchor plans for businesses, and what do they cost?
answer_needs_sean.answer: They are quarterly plans for businesses. Passport Stop is $250 a quarter: a Passport Challenge stop all three months, the register kit, our visit and the Verified badge, a photo shoot, a social post and a results sheet. Passport Anchor is $500 a quarter: everything in Passport Stop, plus the anchor month, a Tour slot, a social campaign and the featured spot in your section.

answer_needs_sean.question: How do I become a Community Manager, and is /lead or /community-managers the right page?
answer_needs_sean.answer: Apply on the Community Manager page. It is a volunteer role, and the team reviews every application.

fix_live.question: What are points for?
fix_live.answer: Points unlock guides, which are 1,111 points each. They also cover asking your Guide directly, and you earn more by taking part.

fix_live.question: Does my city have a Community Manager?
fix_live.answer: South Florida has its Community Manager, and the chapter is getting started now. Most other cities, Orlando and New York included, are still looking for theirs. Open roles are under Opportunities on your dashboard.
